t: A block-based coding editor from the company Codemao, with thin English information.
steps: Find the Codemao Kitten editor on the Codemao website.
Look for the English documentation for the editor blocks.
Ask Codemao about price and school features.
Ask Codemao what data it collects from students.
Test the editor with a teacher account.
Ask IT to review the findings.
Decide whether to use it only after those answers arrive.
